children: Crypto KOL Ansem said he is increasingly bullish on Solana DeFi and described it as one of the most undervalued trading opportunities in this cycle. According to Odaily, he said meme coins drew most market attention in the previous cycle, while protocols such as Jito and Jupiter were still in the early stages of their token lifecycles.

Ansem said Solana’s core infrastructure landscape is now clearer, and low fees, fast execution, and continued growth in on-chain transaction volume are reinforcing the trend. He added that retail investors, institutions, and tokenized stocks are continuing to move on-chain.

title: Ansem Says Solana DeFi Is One of the Most Undervalued Trades This Cycle
